text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Share of boys enrolled in upper secondary school
Comparing net and gross enrollment ratios for boys in upper secondary education. Net enrollment shows the
share of boys of upper secondary school age (typically 15–17 years) who are enrolled, while gross enrollment
includes all boys regardless of age, expressed as a percentage of boys of the same age group.
